race.comment: Off her past couple of starts, CAVALRY GIRL (7) is the one to beat. She's won those by a cumulative 8.3 lengths from the front, far too good at Caulfield Heath over this trip last time. There does look more pressure here but she doesn't have to lead, either way she'll give a huge sight. Wary of the resuming HEDGED (1) who has a fantastic last preparation, up for a long time but continually racing well. Second in a G1 Oakleigh Plate then beaten a neck in the G1 The Galaxy before a break, he's sharp enough to sit off these at 1000m and have last say. BEAST MODE (5) was better in Sydney last time and can prove hard to catch. SIGNATURE SCENT (11) did beat CAVALRY GIRL first up so must have some claims.
